Container.Name: channels-dvr
Container.Overview:
Channels DVR Server with TCP connection tuning for stable streaming.
Based on Debian Bookworm with minimal tini init system.
Key Features: - TCP connection tuning via libkeepalive (fixes stuck connections on Linux) - Proper PUID/PGID mapping (no root-owned files) - TV Everywhere (TVE) support with Google Chrome - Intel QuickSync hardware transcoding - NVIDIA GPU support - App handles its own updates (including pre-releases)

Config.Name: Config Storage
Config.Description: Container Path: /channels-dvr - Stores Channels DVR configuration and binary

Config.Name: Recordings
Config.Description: Container Path: /shares/DVR - Where recordings are stored

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID - Use 99 for nobody on Unraid

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID - Use 100 for users on Unraid

Config.Name: TCP User Timeout
Config.Description: Hard timeout (ms) for connections with unacknowledged data. Forces cleanup of stuck connections. Default 600000 (10 min). Set to 0 to disable.

Config.Name: TCP No Delay
Config.Description: Disable Nagle's algorithm for lower streaming latency. 1=disabled (recommended), 0=enabled.
